Utilities Module

The utilities module provides helper functions for logging, configuration, and state management.

Victor Core Utilities

Core utilities for state management, logging, configuration, and serialization.

Author: Brandon Emery x Victor License: Proprietary - Massive Magnetics

victor_core.utils.setup_logger(name: str, level: int = 20, log_file: str | None = None) → Logger[source]

Set up a logger with consistent formatting.

Parameters:

  • name – Logger name

  • level – Logging level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL)

  • log_file – Optional file path for logging

Returns:

Configured logger instance

Example

>>> logger = setup_logger("victor.tensor", level=logging.DEBUG)
>>> logger.info("Tensor operation complete")
class victor_core.utils.Config(data: Dict[str, Any] | None = None)[source]

Bases: object

Configuration container with dot-notation access and persistence.

Example

>>> config = Config({"model": {"lr": 0.01, "layers": 3}})
>>> print(config.model.lr)  # 0.01
>>> config.model.lr = 0.001
>>> config.save("config.json")
__init__(data: Dict[str, Any] | None = None)[source]
get(key: str, default: Any = None) → Any[source]

Get value with default fallback.

to_dict() → Dict[str, Any][source]

Convert to plain dictionary.

save(filepath: str) → None[source]

Save configuration to JSON file.

Load configuration from JSON file.

class victor_core.utils.StateManager[source]

Bases: object

Manage application state with checkpointing and rollback.

Example

>>> state = StateManager()
>>> state.set("counter", 0)
>>> state.checkpoint("initial")
>>> state.set("counter", 10)
>>> state.rollback("initial")
>>> print(state.get("counter"))  # 0
__init__()[source]
set(key: str, value: Any) → None[source]

Set state value.

get(key: str, default: Any = None) → Any[source]

Get state value with optional default.

delete(key: str) → None[source]

Delete state value.

checkpoint(name: str) → None[source]

Save current state as checkpoint.

rollback(name: str) → None[source]

Restore state from checkpoint.

list_checkpoints() → List[str][source]

List available checkpoint names.

clear() → None[source]

Clear all state.

save(filepath: str) → None[source]

Save state to file.

load(filepath: str) → None[source]

Load state from file.
